results.title: Arthur & Clara
results.overview: Pretentious filmmaker Arthur and entitled high-profile actress Clara find themselves at the same rural farmhouse, to escape from their individual pressures. As they reluctantly start to connect, their shared vulnerability leads them on an accidental journey of self-discovery, revealing what it truly means to be seen.

results.title: An Ordinary Sunday
results.overview: After a night at a bar in the far south of São Paulo, three friends wake up hungover and realize that the fourth never came back. Amid unanswered messages and an attempt to carry on with their Sunday, the wait teeters between the tragic and the comic.

results.title: The Suit
results.overview: A couple engaged in a bizarre legal proceeding confront the source of their problem.

results.title: JOHN
results.overview: After mistreatment at her law firm, a black female lawyer disguises herself as a white man.

results.title: Rétro MotoGP 2025 - Marquez, la renaissance
results.overview: A race by race retrospective of the 2025 MotoGP season, featuring the victories, statistics, and performances of the leading riders that made the year so exciting.

results.title: Dog Day
results.overview: Maria Joana navigates the discoveries and transformations of adolescence. She experiences her first night of freedom and independence at the local Saint John's street celebration, testing her limits and confronting her inner fears — but not without consequences.

results.title: Something You Should Know About Me
results.original_title: Something You Should Know About Me
results.overview: In this sweet and raunchy trans rom-com, insecure cartoonist Al is faced with his most daunting prompt yet: confess his true feelings for his best friend or risk losing him to a handsome nemesis.

results.title: A Film to Remind Us of Utopia
results.original_title: Um Filme para Lembrar da Utopia
results.overview: In Esdras Baptista's film archives, kept at his home for decades, one can feel the fervor of those who believed in a new tomorrow. Filmed in Brazil in the early 1960s, in the heat of a libertarian political movement, the filmmaker's images materialize the incandescence of collective desires at the historic moment of their emergence. Utopia, though unattainable, is never a mere abstraction. A force that mobilizes actions and feelings, it constitutes the impetus necessary for human existence.

results.title: Moscow Cairo
results.overview: In the 90s, and following the dissolution of the Soviet Union and the resulting conflicts, four Russian girls travel to Egypt and start to mingle in the Egyptian society, developing a shared admiration towards it in a way that makes them unwilling to return to their homeland.

results.title: Corrupted Pleasure
results.overview: A corrupted file seduces the viewer

results.title: Go Home
results.overview: A 38-year-old single Dutch woman finds herself like a stranger in her hometown after years of working in Afghanistan with the United Nations.

results.title: Hand of Justice
results.overview: Blagoje Jovović, a war hero, after World War II moves to Buenos Aires. There he tries to lead a normal life, but an encounter with a man with ustasha tattoo brings up old wounds and desire for vengeance.

results.title: NANOcell
results.overview: After an experimental research study goes wrong, Maggie Miller must battle a race against time and a government conspiracy to prevent a technological nightmare from taking over her body.

results.title: Rooster
results.overview: A janitor of the Municipality of Athens, determined to give his six-year-old son the future he himself was denied, enrolls him in a private school. But his chase of the “Greek dream” turns into a tragicomic spiral of conflicts, leading to a bitter revelation: perhaps his illusions were all he truly had.

results.title: Parasocial
results.overview: After achieving breakout success in Hollywood, actor Claire Watson returns to her childhood friends for a dinner party, hoping for a brief escape from the exhaustion of fame. Instead of a warm welcome of familiarity, she is met with an unsettling intensity. Their nostalgia feels rehearsed, their admiration excessive, and a sentimental presentation of their past becomes uncomfortably centred on Claire’s fame. Claire's perspective on her past must be confronted, as this is not what she remembers it being like, where her friends always this way? As the night wears on, small disturbances escalate into violence as the group reveal their true nature. She must now not only battle her conflicting thoughts on nostalgia but also for her own life, as her friends shed any resemblance of humanity and become parasites willing to do whatever it takes to drag Claire to their level.

results.title: Call Me When You Can: A Father's Day Story
results.original_title: Call Me When You Can: A Father's Day Story
results.overview: Work obsessed entrepreneur Roy Walker must rebuild his fractured relationship when his estranged daughter arrives at his secluded beach condo one Father's Day, forcing them both to confront past mistakes and rediscover what truly matters.

results.title: Sex and the Friend Group
results.overview: A shocking confession turns a close friend group upside down, forcing them to confront messy relationships, blurred boundaries, and the chaos that comes when sex, sexuality and friendship collide
